chapter_title: The Apostle asks his Disciples: What is Cloud?
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Cloud
 Teaching


---


**
¶2:**

Know
 that wisdom
 shall be released from the
 five fac
ulties of the natural
 mind and
 shall rise
 above the whole
 plane
 of external
 thought
,
 and it
 becomes
 manifest and
 perceived
 in the rational
 understanding, which stands
 between the natural mind
 below
 and the spiritual mind above.


---


**¶3:**
An
 obscure state of understanding arising from the
 will —
 from
 love
 itself
 — shall ascend toward
 the interior
 heav
ens,
 drawn
 toward
 the form
 of Divine
 Truth in its celestial beauty
,
 which
 she
 presents
 before
 it. The sign
 of this process
 is sudden
 illumination, those
 break
ings-
forth
 of
 insight
 that occur amid
 states
 of spiritual
 crisis
.
 And by
 these
 illumin
ations the interior
 goods
 held
 capt
ive within that
 obsc
ure understanding are
 purified by
 Divine
 Truth,
 according
 to the wisdom
 she
 progress
ively reveals.
 The ruling
 evil
 affections are
 exposed
 and d
isl
odged by these
 sudden illuminations;
 they are
 separated out
 and
 expelled
 from the understanding
 they
 had dominated.


---

**¶4:**

Yet
 immediately
 divine
 truths from
 heaven are
 summoned against
 those
 evil affections, to
 seize and rest
rain them,
 for
 it
 is known that they will
 never produce
 any
 good. Every faculty
 of
 the mind
 they touch
 they render
 spiritu
ally dead and bar
ren. When
 divine
 truths advance
 toward
 them and draw
 near, the
 evil affections flee
 in
 their comp
ulsion.
 They enter
 into
 whatever natural
 form they encounter
 and
 take
 possession
 of it —
 as
 a fals
ity,
 being
 exposed
 and
 driven
 out
,
 fl
ees before
 a
 stronger truth
 that
 purs
ues it to
 arrest it.

---

**
¶5:**
Now, those ruling
 evil affections that are d
islodged from these obsc
ure states
 of understanding and
 se
ize upon
 whatever they encounter — they
 will
 take
 hold
 of any
 vessel
 available
 to them:
 whether
 a
 perception
 into
 which they have found entrance
, or a
 natural
 aff
ection, or the
 human
 will itself. In
 every
 faculty
 they inhab
it they burn
 and consume
 by the fire of their self
-love. For
 these
 are the ruling
 loves
 —
 the offspring
 of self
-love — that have been
 stripped of their
 dominant
 love
 yet still carry its consuming
 nature within
 them.

---

**¶
6:**
In
 contrast, the obscure understanding that ar
ises from truth
 — from
 the waters
 of natural knowledge
 — and
 asc
ends toward the form
 of Divine Truth;
 its sign is the powerful
 declarations
 of divine
 good
, the rever
berations of spiritual
 power
 that res
ound through the rational
 mind
 in
 manif
old forms and
 are in
ward
ly heard. And
 there are times when the evil
 affections belonging
 to such
 states
, which d
well within
 that
 obscure understanding, are on
 occasion constrained and
 bound within the
 tru
ths themselves
. And
 they flee from those
 truths and abandon them.

---


**¶7:**
Now
, they too are such
 that
 every faculty
 of
 the mind they reach, they render
 cold and bar
ren:
 they
 produce
 frozen
 fals
ities and
 hard
ened den
ials and
 the
 dead
ness
 of spiritual
 winter
. They destroy
 the interior
 tru
ths that
 were
 s
own as
 seeds
, and the good works growing
 from them, and every
 living
 perception
 beginning
 to take
 root;
 they lay
 waste
 to
 every
 part
 of the understanding
 they reach.

---

**
¶8:**
Again, divine tru
ths are summoned against them
 to
 seize and
 restrain them.
 Yet
 while these
 divine truths pursue
 them, the
 evil affections accomplish
 their destruction in
 the interval
.


---

**¶9:**

Also
, the obscure understanding that ar
ises from spiritual thought itself
 asc
ends into
 the rational
 mind, drawn toward the form of Divine
 Truth which
 she displays
 before it. Its
 sign is the
 fierce
 dist
urbance
 of thought
 that bl
ows through
 the
 mind
 with
 bitterness —
 the tur
moil of spiritual tem
ptation.

---

**
¶10:**
Within
 those struggles
 of
 thought
 and temp
ests
 of tem
ptation, the interior
 goods of
 life
 are purified. Again, the ruling
 evil affections are stripped from
 the understanding formed
 of
 spiritual thought, and they descend from
 it, ret
aining their
 proper
 nature. Every
 flowing
 truth
 and
 every
 body
 of general
 knowledge they reach, they ag
itate and disturb,
 raising
 up confusion
;
 and
 they overt
urn the doctrinal systems by
 which the
 mind
 navig
ates.
 They bring
 destruction
 to
 the
 ordered
 thought
 of
 the understanding
, and they seize and carry
 away whatever
 they can
 take
 hold of.

---

**
¶11:**
Also
 the understanding
 formed
 of wisdom
 directly
 —
 when
 the
 evil
 affections are
 stripped from it,
 Divine
 Truth herself
 receives
 what
 remains
. Her sign is this:
 that
 you shall find this
 understanding
 proce
eding in peace
 and in
 spiritual
 rest
. The interior
 goods within
 it are purified in peace and tran
quility.
 Again, the evil
 affections that are
 separated
 from it and
 sent
 forth
 — they too
 are seized
 by
 the
 divine
 tru
ths that attend
 them.


---

**¶12:**

Again, the obscure understanding that
 arises from the
 mingled state
 of all
 these
 faculties together
 asc
ends toward the form of Divine Truth.
 Its sign is this: that the interior
 goods within it are purified in still
ness and in
 rest. Yet
 the ruling
 evil affections that are stripped from that
 understanding and come forth
 from
 it — every
 faculty
 they encounter they corrupt
,
 until
 at
 last they are seized and brought
 into
 con
finement among
 their
 kind
.

---

**¶13
:**
The
 resid
ues
 that
 those
 evil affections leave behind them in the
 various
 fac
ulties they have touched
 — whether
 the works
 produced
 by perception
 or
 the offspring
 generated
 by the self
hood — these
 shall
 be gathered
 and
 shall
 w
ither away. They infl
ict great spiritual
 dangers upon
 the mind
.
 But again, those ruling
 evil affections are
 also sent by
 the
 divine truths into
 their con
finement. The
 angels
 separate
 the
 wisdom
 from them
, and cast
 the
 dem
onic fals
ities down into
 the
 seven ou
termost depths
 of the great a
byss — which
 is the containing
 form
 of all
 fals
ities that
 lie beyond the boundary of spiritual life.


---

**¶15
:**
Those
 depths
 desc
end until
 they reach the lowest
 natural
 planes
,
 beneath
 the feet of the Guardian
 who
 stands
 at the boundary between what
 is of
 the spirit
 and what is of mere
 nature
.


---

**¶16:**

Hear also this
: at
 times the divine
 truths are
 sent to seize those ruling
 evil affections. When the evil aff
ections perce
ive the divine truths pursuing
 them, they entr
eat
 them —
 yet
 the
 command
 has
 been given.
 Those
 evil
 affections,
 however, free
 themselves and
 take
 hold
 of perception
 and of
 the self
hood.
 They are consumed into
 the offspring of perception
 and
 of the self
hood's
 own
 life
. The divine truths set a watch
 over them, gu
arding them until the hour when those ruling
 evil affections are
 finally
 stripped from
 the
 perception
 and from the selfhood, and they
 ascend above. They are gathered into
 the higher
 regions and
 p
oured forth
 into
 their original
 forms —
 the
 very
 states
 in which they first
 existed
. The
 remaining
 wisdom
 that
 had
 been
 held
 captive within them is taken from them
. And
 they too
 are cast down into
 those
 seven ou
termost depths within
 the great abyss,
 the
 place to
 which the
 former ones were
 cast. They reach
 that
 con
finement, and the last
 light
 of
 wisdom
 within
 them is extracted
.

---

**¶17
:**
Behold,
 I
 have instructed you concerning
 this obscure understanding: how
 it asc
ends above, and the interior
 goods of
 life within
 it are purified. I have also
 taught you concerning
 the ruling
 evil affections within
 it: how they produce
 these ins
urrections against
 the order
 of heaven
,
 and how they are ultimately
 seized
.
 And they are cast into the ou
termost spiritual
 prison by the divine
 truths, when the command is given
 through
 the power of Divine Truth in
 her
 celestial form. She has authority over
 the entire plane
 of
 the rational
 mind, and she
 pur
ifies every
 good
 of
 life that
 dw
ells within it.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Happen you know that it shall be released from five places and ascend over this great earth and [rise up to the heavens above,] and it is revealed and seen in the atmosphere between.

So, the cloud shall ascend from fire to the heavens towards the likeness of the Virgin of Light that she shall display to it. Its sign is the flashes that occur with lightning storms [; and i]ts exchange [is the purifying of the lives within]. And they shall be purified by her towards [the fullness of] the light that she shall reveal [to them]. The rulers shall be released by the lightning storms and they are freed and sent.

However, [these] angels shall immediately be summoned to them, so that they will seize them, because they know that they shall never do good. Every place they will touch they shall make dead and a loss. Whenever the angels will make towards them and come beside [them], they shall flee in their constraint before them. They go into whatever they will meet upon and assume it, like a robber being abandoned and fleeing before one stronger than him, as he runs after him to arrest him.

Now, those rulers that shall be freed from these clouds and assume whatever they will meet upon [; they shall enter] into the [form] that they did not [possess before. They] will seize this thing, whether indeed a tree to which they have found the way, or animals, or people. Simply, every place that they will assume they shall burn and destroy by the fire of their body. Namely, the rulers, [the] children of fire, they that shall be stripped of the fire.

In contrast, [the] cloud that shall be raised up from water, and comes above towards the Virgin of Light; its sign is the thunder storms and the booms that shall come in the atmosphere in various forms and are heard. [And by those sounds the lives within shall be cleansed.] Again, there are times if the rulers that belong to them, which exist in the cloud, shall on occasion be constrained [in a] water [clou]d. And they flee from it and abandon it.

Now, [they] too are so, in that every place that they will [reach], they shall make frost and hail and snow. [They rui]n the seed-corn and the fruits and the plants; and they [lay waste to] every place [that] they will reach.
Again, [ang]els shall be summoned to them who seize them. Still, while the angels [ru]sh after them in order to seize them, they shall make this destruction.

Also, [the cl]oud that will be raised up from wind ascends to the atmosphere between, towards the likeness of the Virgin that she shall display to it. Its sign is [the s]torm wind that shall blow with bitterness.

So, in those winds and tempests shall the lives be purified. Again, the rulers will be stripped of the cloud of wind and they descend from it, safe in their image. All the rivers and the seas that they will reach and arrive at, they shall make waves in them and raise [up great turbulence,] and they [overturn] the ships. They wreak destruction [upon the waters] and they seize and bring them [down to the deep].

Also the cloud, the one of light, immediately they will be stripped of it [and it comes before] the Virgin. She shall display its sign too [as she receives it]. And its sign is this, in that you shall find it sailing in stillness and calm. The lives in it shall be cleansed in stillness and calm. Again, the rulers that will be stripped of it [, those] that will come forth [from it;] they shall put [on a body] and they take [to what they find. But] there [also] the angels seize them.

Again, the cloud that shall be raised up from the mingled air comes above towards [the image] of the Virgin. Its sign is this, in that [the lives] are purified in it in stillness and [rest. And these rulers] that will be stripped of that cloud and come from it; every place that they will find [and reach,] they shall make it [a place of corruption,] one of [desolation;] until [at last] they are seized and taken to their midst.

Their strippings, that they shall leave behind them in various places they will have reached, whether the produce of the trees or the offspring of the fleshes, they shall be taken midst [these things and they shall] wither away. They shall inflict great dangers, but again those rulers also the angels shall send to their midst. They bring the light from them and cast the demons down to these seven outer ditches of the great sea; which is the vessel of the waters that are outside the world.
Those ditches and the [abysses descend] until they reach the earths below [the] feet of the Porter.

Hear also [this:] for sometimes these angels shall be sent to them, to seize the rulers. Whenever the rulers [perceive them and flee,] for the angels rush after them. They beseech them [, but they shall not be spared by] they that are given the command. However, [t]hose [rul]ers shall be freed from them alone and assume [the tree] and [the fle]sh. They are consumed by this offspring [of the] tree and that of flesh. The angels shall set a [watch] over them, that they might guard them until the hour when [those r]ulers will be stripped of tree and [flesh; a]nd they go up above. They shall be gathered [to the heights] above, and they are poured out [once more] in their first for[ms, the im]ages in which they first were. They take the light from them, which had remained behind in them. And they too are cast down to these seven outer [path]s that are in the great sea; the place to where these former ones [were cas]t. They shall reach their midst [and are held there;] and the light that is in them is taken.

Behold now, I have instructed you about this cloud: How it shall ascend above, and the lives that are in it are purified. I have also taught you of the rulers that are in it: how they shall make these {rebellions} and how they shall be {caught}. And they are cast to the outer prison by the angels, when the command is given to them through the power of the Virgin of Light. She has authority over the entire zone, and cleanses the life that is in it.
